import type { UserWorkspaceConfig, TestUserConfig, TestProjectConfiguration, TestProjectInlineConfiguration, UserProjectConfigExport } from 'vitest/config'
type Equal<A,B>=(<T>()=>T extends A?1:2) extends (<T>()=>T extends B?1:2)?true:false
type Check<T extends true>=T
type RootKeys=Check<Equal<string extends keyof UserWorkspaceConfig?true:false,false>>
type Browser=Check<Equal<TestUserConfig['browser'],NonNullable<UserWorkspaceConfig['test']>['browser']>>
export const result:UserWorkspaceConfig={}
